    "Autofill functionality occasionally behaves inconsistently or requires manual adjustment.",

  "overall_experience": "This software engineer likely found Bitwarden to be a highly effective and secure solution for managing their credentials. They appreciated its strong functionality, cross-platform compatibility, and especially its cost-effectiveness for an organization of its size.
